statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of presyncope and transient loss of consciousness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is ordered
The service is to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances and guide subsequent management
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The service is excluded from the plan's coverage
